Load overall report type totals from data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Type.csv (cp1252 encoding)

operatorProperties.code:
def process(type_reports):
    import pandas as pd
    df = type_reports.copy()
    # Use the row that contains the real headers
    header_row_idx = df.index[df.iloc[:,0].astype(str).str.strip().eq('Theft Type')].tolist()[0]
    new_cols = df.iloc[header_row_idx].tolist()
    df = df.iloc[header_row_idx+1:].copy()
    df.columns = new_cols
    # Drop empty/footer rows
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Theft Type','Theft Subtype'], how='all')
    df = df[~df['Theft Type'].astype(str).str.startswith('Source:', na=False)]
    df = df[~df['Theft Type'].astype(str).str.contains('Consumers can report multiple', na=False)]

    # Clean numeric
    df['# of Reports'] = (
        df['# of Reports'].astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df['# of Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['# of Reports'], errors='coerce')

    # Clean strings
    df['Theft Type'] = df['Theft Type'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['Theft Subtype'] = df['Theft Subtype'].astype(str).str.strip()
    return df[['Theft Type','Theft Subtype','# of Reports']]

def process(report_type):
    import pandas as pd
    df = report_type.copy()
    # Find the row where Report Type == 'Identity Theft' and pick the '# of Reports' value
    # The file has multiple header/metadata rows; normalize strings.
    col0 = df.columns[0]
    col1 = df.columns[1]
    tmp = df[[col0, col1]].rename(columns={col0: 'Report Type', col1: '# of Reports'})
    tmp['Report Type'] = tmp['Report Type'].astype(str).str.strip()
    tmp['# of Reports'] = tmp['# of Reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
    tmp = tmp[tmp['Report Type'].str.lower() == 'identity theft']
    # Coerce numeric
    tmp['# of Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(tmp['# of Reports'], errors='coerce')
    tmp = tmp.dropna(subset=['# of Reports'])
    return tmp[['Report Type', '# of Reports']].head(1)

def process(clean_type_reports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = clean_type_reports.copy()
    # normalize for robust match
    df['Theft Type_norm'] = df['Theft Type'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['Theft Subtype_norm'] = df['Theft Subtype'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

    target = df[(df['Theft Type_norm'] == 'bank account') & (df['Theft Subtype_norm'] == 'new accounts')]

    out = target[['Theft Type', 'Theft Subtype', '# of Reports']].copy()
    # ensure single row even if duplicates
    out = out.groupby(['Theft Type', 'Theft Subtype'], as_index=False)['# of Reports'].sum()
    return out
